question: What Are the Types of DCS IO Cards?
body_html:
DCS IO card types fall into four basic categories: analog input, analog output, digital input and digital output, each matched to one kind of field signal.

CardSignalTypical device
Analog input (AI)4 to 20 mA, often with HARTPressure, flow, level, temperature transmitters
Analog output (AO)4 to 20 mAControl valve positioners, VFD speed reference
Digital input (DI)24 VDC contactLimit switches, pushbuttons
Digital output (DO)On or offRelays, solenoid valves, lamps

Cards commonly have 8, 16 or 32 channels.
